attachments.content: Automatic-Garden-Waterer - A project that switches a valve to water plants in the garden.

object.content: Along the same lines as my previous post, I've put some time into designing the schematic for the Arduino and 16x2 character LCD. I used Fritzing for this, although I'd typically use Eagle for creating schematics. You can tell that Fritzing is still a work in progress, but for creating simple schematics for projects containing an Arduino, it can't be beat. You can check out the schematics (called Controller.fzz) that I created at https://github.com/dwaq/Automatic-Garden-Waterer
